Claude then prompted the person to specify which direction(s) were most relevant and what the primary purpose of the research was, offering options ranging from supporting their own agent system design to academic surveying of recent advances. The conversation ended before the person provided their selections, so no specific papers were analyzed or recommendations finalized.
